description: Get the exact original version, file, typed anchor (including coordinate definitions), quoted context, message continuation and independent source/edit capabilities. Evidence may be unavailable; do not invent a screenshot or a successful location. Read the original version, then inspect the latest editable version separately. Default to update/edit on the SAME slug with expected_version and an operation_key; do not publish a new site or resolve the discussion automatically.

share_token.description: Token from a user-provided share URL; carries only that share permission.

slug.description: Artifact identifier returned by find/publish, or the slug in its /s/ URL. Not a local path.

tenant_id.description: Destination tenant for creation; defaults to the account tenant.
